hints.title: Initial City Power Calculation
hints.text: Precompute the initial power delivered to each city using a sliding window or prefix sum array.

hints.title: Monotonic Target Search
hints.text: If a target minimum power T is achievable using at most k additional stations, any target smaller than T is also achievable.

hints.title: Greedy Difference Array Coverage
hints.text: When scanning city i whose power is below target, place needed stations at min(n - 1, i + r) to maximize forward reach.

hints.title: Binary Search and Difference Greedy Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search on target power with O(n) difference array validation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all combinations of station placements is combinatorial.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space stores city power and difference array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines binary search on monotonic target answer with greedy difference array updates.
